description: A mise shim without any pinned version (neither global nor repo) fails at call time with 'ERROR No version is set for shim: <tool>' — hit by 'just bootstrap' running lefthook.
resolution: Pin repo-relevant tools in .mise.toml (lefthook = "2.1.14", 2026-10-23) so 'just bootstrap' is self-contained instead of depending on global machine state. Binary availability installs no git hooks; the hook opt-in remains the explicit 'lefthook install' step.
